1. Works Across Multiple Blockchains: Mango Network lets different blockchains, even ones like Bitcoin and Dogecoin that don’t use smart contracts, talk to each other easily. This helps move assets and data between chains without problems.

1. Bitcoin and Similar Chains

Mango Network can help Bitcoin and similar chains (like Dogecoin) do more things by adding smart contract features. This means Bitcoin can be used in more advanced financial applications.
